no_images: No images in your library yet

experience_media_hint: Add photos from your library, then pick one as the cover shown on the storefront.
create_tour_operator_subtitle: Set up the business you'll manage.
operator_no_access_body: You don't have access to this tour operator, or it doesn't exist.
join_existing_team_body: If someone else is setting up the tour operator you'll work with, you don't need to create one here. They'll invite you by email — just wait for the invitation to arrive.
no_experiences_body: Create your first experience to start selling.
experience_description_hint: A short summary shown on cards and in search.
translations_description: Localize this experience for each supported language. Empty fields fall back to the default language.
translation_fallback_help: Leave a field empty to use the default-language text.
translation_slug_help: The URL for this language. Leave empty to reuse the default.
translations_no_languages: This operator has only one language. Add a supported language in Settings to translate this experience.
translations_no_languages_generic: This operator has only one language. Add a supported language in Settings to translate.
name_translations_description: Translate the name for each supported language. An empty field falls back to the default language.
slug_taken: That URL is already in use for this language.
featured_hint: Featured experiences are highlighted on your storefront.
drag_or_click: Drag an image here, or click to browse
account_description: Manage your personal profile and password.
avatar_description: A photo to represent you across the workspace.
avatar_constraints: PNG, JPG or GIF, up to 10 MB.
avatar_too_large: That image is too large (max 10 MB).
remove_avatar_body: Your avatar will be removed and replaced with your initials.
interface_language_description: The language of the admin interface. Only affects you.
change_password_description: Update the password you use to sign in.
logo_too_large: That image is too large. Maximum size is 25 MB.
logo_wrong_type: That file type isn't supported. Please choose an image.
invite_member_subtitle: Send an email invitation to join this operator.
invitation_duplicate: That email is already a member or has a pending invitation.
languages_description: The languages your storefront content is available in.
seo_hint: How your storefront appears in search results and when shared. Each language can override these in Translations.
og_image_hint: Shown when a link to your storefront is shared. Uploading adds it to your media library.
policies_description: The legal documents your storefront links in its footer.
no_policies_body: Write your cancellation, privacy, terms and legal notice documents.
policy_type_hint: Which document this is. It sets the storefront URL and cannot be changed later.
policy_type_taken: That policy already exists. Edit the existing one instead.
policy_body_hint: Raw HTML, stored exactly as written and rendered as-is on your storefront.
delete_policy_body: The storefront will stop linking and serving it. This cannot be undone.
policy_translations_description: Translate each policy for your supported languages. An empty field falls back to the default language.
no_permission_body: You don't have permission to do this. Ask an admin of this operator if you need access.
operator_translations_description: Translate your shop's own text for each supported language. An empty field falls back to the default language.
slogan_hint: A short tagline shown on your storefront (max 80).
short_description_hint: A one-line summary of your business (max 150).
primary_language_help: The default language shown to visitors.
supported_languages_help: The languages customers can view your content in.
no_pickup_locations_body: Pickup locations are the meeting points travelers choose when booking.
pickup_location_name_taken: A pickup location with this name already exists.
pickup_time_hint: The local time travelers meet at this point.
audience_name_taken: An audience with this name already exists.
pax_per_unit_hint: How many people one unit covers — 1 for per-person tiers, more for group or table packages.
no_audiences_body: Audiences are the pricing tiers (Adults, Children, …) you attach to departures.
no_media_body: Images and files you upload will appear here.
media_rejected: Couldn't upload {names} — must be JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 25 MB
remove_media_body: This permanently deletes the file. Anything still using it will lose its image.
revoke_invitation_body: The accept link will stop working immediately. This can't be undone — you'd need to send a new invitation.
transfer_ownership_body: They'll become the owner and you'll be demoted to admin. Only the new owner can transfer it back.
remove_member_body: They'll immediately lose access to this operator. You can invite them again later.
leave_team_body: You'll immediately lose access to this operator and be sent back to your operators.
resource_not_found: It may have been removed, or you don't have access to it.
validation_email: Please enter a valid email address
validation_password_uppercase: Must contain at least one uppercase letter
validation_password_lowercase: Must contain at least one lowercase letter
validation_password_number: Must contain at least one number
validation_password_special: Must contain at least one special character
validation_primary_language_supported: The primary language must be one of the supported languages
validation_slug: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens
validation_new_password_same: The new password must be different from the current one
no_availability_body: Departures you schedule for your experiences will appear here.
cancel_slot_body: The departure is cancelled permanently and can no longer be booked. This cannot be undone.
edit_capacity_hint: Capacity per audience for this departure. It cannot go below the seats already booked.
capacity_below_booked: Capacity cannot be below the seats already booked.
choose_experience_hint: Availability is scheduled per experience — pick the one these departures belong to.
recurring_hint: Creates a departure on every selected weekday between the two dates.
no_audiences_for_slots_body: Departures are priced per audience (adults, children, …). Create at least one audience, then come back to schedule availability.
validation_pricing_row_incomplete: Every row needs an audience, a price and a capacity
validation_duplicate_audience: The same audience is listed twice
title: Title
no_pages_body: Create static content — About us, Contact, FAQs, policies — to show on your storefront.
handle_hint: The page's URL segment: /pages/…. Permanent — changing it later is a deliberate rename.
page_handle_taken: A page with this handle already exists
page_body_hint: Raw HTML, stored exactly as written.
seo_title_hint: Overrides the browser/search title (max 70). Empty uses the page title.
seo_description_hint: The search-result snippet (max 320). Empty means none.
template_suffix_hint: Alternate page template (used once themes exist). Empty uses the base template.
rename_handle_hint: The old URL will stop working — redirects come with the storefront.
delete_page_body: The page and its translations are removed permanently. This cannot be undone.
no_invitations_body: Invite teammates to help run the operator — pending and past invitations appear here.
delete_pickup_location_body: The meeting point is removed permanently. This cannot be undone.
no_activity_body: Actions your team takes across the operator will appear here.
validation_window_end_before_start: Must not be before the first date
delete_metafield_definition_body: This also permanently deletes every value stored for it across your experiences or pages.
no_metafield_definitions_body: Define custom fields — subtitles, care notes, specs — and fill them in on each experience or page.
metafield_identifier_taken: A metafield with this namespace and key already exists.
metafield_type_hint: How values are validated and how themes read them. Permanent.
metafield_key_hint: The stable identifier themes reference. Permanent.
metafields_hint: Custom fields defined in Content → Metafields.
delete_metaobject_definition_body: This permanently deletes the type, every entry of it, and all their values.
no_metaobject_definitions_body: Define reusable content types — size guides, FAQs, guide profiles — then create entries of them.
metaobject_type_field_hint: The slug themes reference. Unique — a duplicate is rejected. Permanent.
metaobject_type_taken: A metaobject type with this slug already exists.
metaobject_fields_incomplete: Every field needs a name, a slug-shaped key and a type.
metaobject_fields_duplicate_key: Two fields share the same key.
metaobject_add_field_hint: Existing entries simply have the new field unset.
metaobject_rename_field_hint: Only the display name changes — the key and type are permanent.
metaobject_remove_field_body: Every entry's stored value for this field is permanently deleted.
metaobject_field_key_taken: A field with this key already exists on this type.
delete_metaobject_body: The entry and its values are permanently deleted.
no_metaobjects_body: Create the first entry of this type.
metaobject_handle_hint: The entry's stable identifier, unique within its type.
metaobject_handle_taken: An entry with this handle already exists for this type.
metafield_reference_pin_hint: Entries of this metaobject type become the valid values. Permanent.
no_menus_body: Menus define your storefront navigation. Create one to get started.
menu_handle_hint: The theme references the menu by this handle. It can't be changed later.
menu_handle_taken: A menu with this handle already exists.
rename_menu_hint: The title is the internal label — the handle the theme references stays the same.
delete_menu_confirm_body: The menu and all its items will be permanently deleted. A theme referencing its handle will simply show no navigation.
no_menu_items: No items yet. Edit the menu to add navigation links.
menu_items_target_required: Every experience or page link needs a target.
menu_items_url_required: Every external link needs a URL.
store_access_hint: Control who can see your storefront while you get ready to launch.
store_access_toggle: Restrict access to visitors with the password
store_access_toggle_hint: Visitors see a password page instead of your storefront until they enter it.
store_access_password_hint: The password you share with people who should get in. Leaving it unchanged keeps the current one.
store_access_password_required: A password is required to enable password protection.
visitor_message_hint: Shown on the password page — set expectations, like “We’re launching soon”.
inbox_empty_body: Messages from your storefront's contact form will land here.
inbox_delete_confirm_body: The message will be permanently deleted. This can't be undone.
media_alt_hint: What the image shows, for screen readers and when it fails to load. Leave it empty only if the image is purely decorative.
media_alt_placeholder: Kayakers paddling past a limestone cliff
brand_description: The images and words a storefront theme uses to present your shop.
brand_slogan_hint: A short line under your name — up to 80 characters.
brand_short_description_hint: A sentence or two for cards and previews — up to 150 characters.
brand_logo_hint: The main logo, shown in the header.
brand_cover_hint: The wide image at the top of your storefront.
brand_image_remove_body: The storefront falls back to its default until you set a new one. The file stays in your media library.
operator_details_description: Your shop's name, address and contact details, and the timezone and currency it operates in.
operator_handle_fixed: Fixed — it is your storefront address, so changing it would break every link to your shop.
operator_timezone_change_body: Departures already scheduled keep their clock time, so a 10:00 sailing stays 10:00 — but in the new timezone that is a different moment. Nothing reschedules them for you. Check your availability after saving.
